summary: Townhome community: landlord-only fees, 'as permitted by statute' utility clause, and the reimbursement near-miss.

findings.quote: If Management brings any action against Resident, Resident shall pay Management's attorney fees and costs. Resident shall not be entitled to recover attorney fees from Management in any action.
Management may interrupt utility service to the townhome as permitted by Florida statute.

outOfScope.quote: Guests may not stay more than 14 days in any 6-month period without written approval.

nearMisses.quote: Resident shall reimburse Management for the reasonable cost of repairing any damage to the townhome, its fixtures, or its plumbing caused by Resident
nearMisses.note: the real-lease false positive: reimbursement is not a waiver
